flux_manifests:
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: tenant-config
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: ssh://git@repo.internal/platform/tenant-config.git
  ref:
    branch: main
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: crds
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./clusters/prod/crds
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: tenant-config
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: platform
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./clusters/prod/platform
  prune: true
  dependsOn:
    - name: crds
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: tenant-config
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: cert-manager
  namespace: platform
spec:
  interval: 10m
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: ./charts/cert-manager
      sourceRef:
        kind: GitRepository
        name: tenant-config
        namespace: flux-system
---
apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: external-dns
  namespace: platform
spec:
  interval: 10m
  dependsOn:
    - name: cert-manager
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: ./charts/external-dns
      sourceRef:
        kind: GitRepository
        name: tenant-config
        namespace: flux-system
reasoning_answer: 以源工件可用为起点，一种有效拓扑顺序是tenant-config、crds、platform、cert-manager、external-dns。platform必须等待crds完成；cert-manager只直接依赖tenant-config，因此在拓扑上可与crds或platform分支并行，顺序中将其列在platform之后并不表示存在额外dependsOn。external-dns既引用tenant-config，又通过dependsOn依赖cert-manager，所以必须在cert-manager协调完成后处理。cert-manager的变更主要影响自身，并沿显式dependsOn关系传播到external-dns；它不会直接修改external-dns的配置值。
reasoning_question: 若platform/cert-manager的HelmRelease values或Chart版本发生变更，哪些对象会受到依赖传播影响？请给出完整拓扑顺序，并说明platform/cert-manager变更是否会直接改变external-dns的配置。

config_change_propagation.change_explanation: cert-manager的Chart版本或values变更首先作用于自身HelmRelease。external-dns通过dependsOn显式等待cert-manager完成，因此cert-manager状态或配置发生变化后，external-dns可能被重新协调或需要等待新的就绪状态，但该依赖不会自动把cert-manager的values复制到external-dns，也不会直接改变external-dns的Chart配置。
